svg.aria-label: Figure 2. Five conditioning paradigms drawn as block schematics with 2x2 attention masks. Cross-Attention and Layer-wise KV-Cache VLAs have one noise source. Joint Video-Action, Video-Then-Action and Direct-Action world action models have two, and bars give the measured share of trajectory variance carried by each noise source.
